certificate.family: near-contract-standards 5.29.0 FungibleToken + storage management; reference build of near-sdk-rs examples/fungible-token (tag near-sdk-v5.29.0)
certificate.statement: In the Lean model of the library: total_supply equals the sum of balances in every reachable state; the ft_transfer_call settlement refunds at most the transferred amount and at most what the receiver still holds, conserving sender plus receiver (or burning if the sender unregistered); the settlement callback has effect only when the token itself is the caller; no call by anyone else lowers a holder's balance except the settlement of a transfer made to that holder; unregister and storage deposit behave as stated in PROPERTIES.md. This wasm conforms to the model on the kit's traces.
assumptions: Conformance of the wasm to the model is tested on 1000 traces, not proved for all inputs.
No access keys on the token account.
Methods a token adds on top of the library (mint, burn, pause, owner) are outside this certificate.
The settlement callback gets exactly 5 Tgas as in the library; running out of gas is a failed receipt.
